== Summary ==
The final four of the [[2007 Match Play Championship]], January 2007 (poster's file name "FinalFour"). The final four, left to right: [[Greg Shaw]] (black American Eagle hoodie; matches [[:File:2009 World Championship shaw trample.jpg]]), [[Michael Pistone]] (blue #18 jersey; matches [[:File:Michael Pistone 2008 Match Play Championship.jpg]]), [[Reid Smith]] (striped button-down shirt; matches [[:File:Reid Smith 2007 Match Play Championship game.jpg]] and [[:File:Reid Smith 2018 Match Play Championship.jpg]]), and [[Brad Eier]] (green "TEAM OHIO" T-shirt; matches [[:File:Brad Eier 2007 World Championship.jpg]]).

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum by Aglets: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=193821#p193821 post 193821], "Pictures, Pictures, and more Pictures from the MPC" (topic 13762), 27 January 2007. Photobucket album MKole, image FinalFour.jpg. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005909/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t13762.html Internet Archive]
* '''Watermark:''' This copy carries the Groupsy/Photobucket watermark that Photobucket stamped on re-served images; no unwatermarked copy was found (the Photobucket album is no longer public).
